title: Space used by the clearing machine
statement: Let $k$ be the number of work tapes, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, choose a tape $i<k$, and let $w$ assign a Boolean word to each tape. At every time $t$, the clearing machine started with these words visits at most $|w_i|+2$ distinct cells on tape $i$, and it visits exactly one distinct cell on each tape $j\ne i$.
